newsitem.title: GREECE: EU SAYS GREECE'S 96 FUND ABSORPTION SATISFACTORY.
newsitem.headline: EU SAYS GREECE'S 96 FUND ABSORPTION SATISFACTORY.

text.p: European Commissioner for Regional Policies, Monika Wulf-Mathies, said on Friday Greece's absorption of EU funds in 1996 was satisfactory and similar to that of other member states in the last two years.

"I believe the fund absorption rate was good in 1996. There have been some delays in the implementation of programmes for tourism, the post service and the Organisation of Greek Railways. However, we are trying in cooperation with the Greek government to speed things up," Mathies told a news conference.
She said that since her last visit in May 1995, Greece's overall improvement was significant.

"I think the government's will to achieve the targets of the second Community Support Framework and the Cohesion Fund is iron-strong and I am confident it will do its best in this direction," she said.

The Greek government also plans to attract private investment for construction and infrastructure projects as there is not enough financing for these projects. Tenders will be held this year, she added. --Margarita Sotiropoulou, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
